last_completed_unit.finding: Pinned official Cargo documentation states that when Cargo.lock exists, cargo fetch downloads git and registry dependencies so later Cargo commands can run offline unless the lockfile changes. It also documents --offline as preventing network access and restricting resolution to locally downloaded crates, with possible dependency-resolution differences from online mode; --frozen is equivalent to --locked plus --offline.
last_completed_unit.phase1_interpretation: This is a useful cache-prefetch/offline-execution pattern but does not itself eliminate the Phase-1 execution dependency. cargo fetch normally performs network acquisition before offline reuse, and later Cargo commands still require an actual Cargo process. Therefore this exact source does not prove a scheduled-Chat-native, zero-residual-executor route.
